integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, cinematic period drama, a fixed close-up frames Xu Qingwan holding little Nuonuo in her arms, her fingertips clenched tight, her eyes full of anxiety. A kerosene lamp casts warm flickering light across their faces in the hushed stone house. The quiet, tense young woman (S1) says softly: <d>[Chinese] 墨川，我还是觉得你太冲动了。</d> [Shot 2] At 00:02.000, the shot cuts to a medium view from behind: Shen Mochuan gives no reply and walks slowly with quiet footsteps toward the window sealed with oiled cloth, gazing down toward the mountain foot. The camera trails his back with a gentle tracking move. [Shot 3] At 00:04.000, the shot cuts to a slow push-in along his line of sight, revealing a wide vista: Huangniwan village spreads below, and the family's old brick-tile house sits steeped in the warm-orange glow of the setting sun. Shen Fulai's family has already moved in; a thin curl of chimney smoke rises from the roof. [Shot 4] At 00:06.000, the shot cuts to a side-profile close-up of Shen Mochuan staring silently down at the courtyard below. In a low, deep voice (S2) he says: <d>[Chinese] 住吧，好好住。七天以后，这房子白送给我，我都不会再踏进一步半步。</d> [Shot 5] At 00:08.000, the shot cuts to a close view of the oiled cloth window: a mountain wind gusts through the pass, the cloth's edges fluttering and bulging slightly as damp, musty water vapor pours into the stone house. [Shot 6] At 00:10.000, the shot cuts to a held extreme close-up of Shen Mochuan's face: his nostrils twitch faintly as he catches the scent, and his brows knit tightly. He says in an off-screen voiceover: <d>[Chinese] 这风里，有水的味道。不是河水里，是暴雨将至的那种闷湿。比他预想的，要早。</d> while his lips remain completely closed. His eyes hold on the oiled cloth as the oppressive, foreboding ambience closes the scene.

overall_soundscape: The stone house is hushed under the faint hiss of the kerosene lamp flame. Slow quiet footsteps cross the floor, then mountain wind rises steadily outside, the oiled cloth flapping and swelling as humid air seeps into the room.

non_diegetic_music: Sparse low strings at a slow tempo, gradually darkening in tone and swelling slightly as the wind rises, fading into a sustained dissonant drone at the end.
